knowledge_checks.title: Active Recall: 4.2.3
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Explain how a GLM joins exponential-family response, linear predictor η, and link g(μ)=η. Distinguish η from the link.
hints: Use CMP language from today's notes.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Response in exponential family; η = Xβ; g(μ)=η links mean to predictor. Link ≠ η.
knowledge_checks.common_mistake: Skipping the LO hinge or swallowing the next LO.

knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 4.2.3
knowledge_checks.prompt: Name one non-Normal family and its canonical link. Justify from mean range — not software default.
knowledge_checks.model_answer: Poisson–log (canonical): mean positive; log maps (0,∞) to ℝ for η. Or binomial–logit similarly.
